issue.body:
## Objective

Execute the smallest runtime falsification gate from merged Issue #11 / PR #15 before any broader LEAN integration.

Base/source of truth: `feat/alpaca-paper-foundation` at current head after merged PRs #11/#12/#14. Read:
- `trading_agent_starter/LEAN_CONTRACT_QUALIFICATION_20261018.md`
- `trading_agent_starter/research/lean_qualification_011/FIXTURE_MATRIX.md`
- `.agents/skills/trading-project/SKILL.md`

## Scope

Implement and run **Q01–Q03 only** in an isolated qualification host. Do not continue to Q04–Q33 in this issue even if the terminal gate passes.

Pin the LEAN source commit and all resolved build/runtime dependencies. Keep research Python 3.13 isolated from the LEAN host. Dependency acquisition/build setup may use ordinary public package/source access, but the actual fixture runs must be network-denied and require no broker/provider credentials or paid service.

Test the ordinary backtesting transaction/removal path, not a mocked-away substitute. Verify whether the documented public interception seam can prevent default delisting liquidation while preserving unresolved holdings/exposure and without invented cash or denominator changes.

## Immediate stop / failure conditions

Stop and return `LEAN_BLOCKER_FOUND` if any of these are required or observed:
- unpreventable forced delisting fill;
- unresolved holding/exposure disappears through cleanup/removal;
- cash/settlement is invented without fixture evidence;
- scientific outcome/denominator changes to accommodate LEAN;
- reflection/private-member access or a durable LEAN core patch is required;
- paid entitlement, authenticated broker/provider connection or secret is required to run the synthetic gate.

If the spike cannot be completed for a bounded technical reason without establishing a blocker, return `LEAN_TERMINAL_GATE_INCOMPLETE` with the exact missing fact. If all Q01–Q03 variants pass exactly, return `LEAN_TERMINAL_GATE_PASS`.

## Evidence and validation

- Freeze exact input and expected-output fixtures before execution.
- Compare ordered business events, positions, cash, unresolved claims and hashes; no equity-curve tolerance.
- Run from a clean process at least twice with network denied and prove deterministic canonical outputs.
- Record source/build/input/config/output hashes and exact LEAN/runtime versions.
- Keep existing repository scientific/runtime files unchanged except for the issue-scoped qualification artifact and any minimal test harness needed for this spike.
- Run the repository 240-test suite/demo and hosted Ubuntu/Windows CI on the final PR head.
- Fresh independent review before merge.

## Boundaries

No Databento work, FMBH/Amendment 005/candidate change, alpha/performance experiment, broad LEAN migration, Q04–Q33 implementation, broker plugin install/qualification, Paper/Live, credentials, paid calls/purchases or scientific registration change.

## Workflow

Use a dedicated branch `research/issue-17-lean-terminal-spike`. Prefer Codex **Goal mode** because the outcome/stop condition is explicit. Persist a checkpoint before any usage interruption and resume from it; do not redo completed build/source work. Stop at the Q01–Q03 decision and open a draft PR to `feat/alpaca-paper-foundation`.
issue.title: Run LEAN terminal-outcome qualification spike (Q01–Q03 only)
